title: A Discussion: Later That Same Day
coreMove: Use Cheese language as a mirror before a label: name the lost reward, admit the fear, and choose one small search with someone affected before blame hardens.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers stuck in resentment after a work disruption
exampleSpecs.stakes: the next useful contact will not happen while blame owns the day
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show a fired job and Hem-like resentment becoming a concrete search

exampleSpecs.audience: team leads who need a non-blaming way to discuss resistance
exampleSpecs.stakes: a group can turn a fear exercise into gossip unless the mirror comes first
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use the one raised hand and nearly all hands contrast to reveal projection

exampleSpecs.stakes: a digital product may arrive too late if old sales pride wins
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show printed encyclopedias, door-to-door sales, and digital pressure in one meeting

exampleSpecs.audience: owners facing larger competitors and delayed reinvention
exampleSpecs.stakes: the family can learn from missed movement without denying outside pressure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: turn big-box competitors into a question about moving first

exampleSpecs.audience: parents helping a child through a painful move
exampleSpecs.stakes: new joy should not be used to rush grief over the old life
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show Illinois, Vermont, and skiing without denying the loss

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders managing different reactions to change
exampleSpecs.stakes: role language can guide support or become a ranking system
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use Sniff, Scurry, Hem, and Haw to tailor support during layoffs
